scripts.install:all: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix app run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix app test -- --ci && npm run test:server
scripts.test:server: npm --prefix server run db:start && npm --prefix server test
scripts.web:build: rm -rf server/public/app && cd app && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://tutor.chalkpis.com EXPO_WEB_BASE_URL=/app npx expo export --platform web --clear --output-dir ../server/public/app && rm -f ../server/public/app/metadata.json && ! grep -rq 127.0.0.1:8787 ../server/public/app/_expo
